lines.text: Every semester, thousands of answer scripts. Millions of handwritten pages.
And behind every page, a student's future.
Introducing CampX Digital Evaluation. Powered by Medha AI.
Upload one ZIP of scanned scripts. CampX splits every booklet, reads its cover, removes the student's identity, and checks each script for tampering, before an evaluator ever sees it.
Then Medha reads. Every line of handwriting is transcribed, corrected, and mapped to the right question, even when an answer runs across pages.
Each answer is checked against your answer key, point by point. Medha suggests a mark, and shows exactly why.
But the final word belongs to your faculty. Evaluators see the script and Medha's suggestions side by side. Accept, adjust, or override, in seconds. Anything uncertain is flagged for a closer look.
Faster results. Consistent marking. Complete control.
